covers: LangChain partner packages: ChatOpenAI with a model= literal and a model_name= module constant, ChatAnthropic, AzureChatOpenAI as azure_openai
each chat-model constructor is a client and a call record that carries its model; invoke/predict_messages on the built model keep its routing
a base_url from a module constant pointing at another host is custom_base_url
a ChatOpenAI with no model is a missing_model gap; an AzureChatOpenAI with no model= is not
the deprecated `from langchain.chat_models import ChatOpenAI` form
a file that sets OPENAI_API_BASE makes its OpenAI chat models unknown with an endpoint_env gap, not its ChatAnthropic
OpenAIEmbeddings and its calls are not tracked; an api_key and a gateway host never reach the output
notes: Synthetic. Truth is what each line does at run time, except where a policy turns it into a gap. A LangChain chat-model constructor builds the provider SDK client and fixes the model every request on it uses, so each one is both a client and a call record (chain as written, request=false) with its model; calls on the built model (invoke, predict_messages) keep its routing and carry no model of their own. gateway.py:7 is given a module-constant base_url on another host, so it and routed.invoke are custom_base_url. gateway.py:8 passes no model, so LangChain's default applies: a missing_model gap. AzureChatOpenAI serves its deployment, so gateway.py:9 needs no model; its model= is still listed, and the deployment name is not a captured value. legacy_bot.py uses the deprecated langchain.chat_models import in a file with no openai.api_* settings, so it is direct. It never mentions a lowercase `openai` or `anthropic`: it is read because `ChatOpenAI` is a PREFILTER needle in usages/python.rs (the match is case-sensitive). local_proxy.py may set OPENAI_API_BASE (only when USE_LOCAL_PROXY is set) before assistant is built, so its OpenAI chat model and the call on it are unknown with an endpoint_env gap; LangChain's ChatAnthropic does not read that variable, so critic stays direct. OpenAIEmbeddings (chains.py:11) and embeddings.embed_query (chains.py:27) are not tracked: their model and the api_key passed to drafter must not be output.
